# Shelf

**Definition.** A fixed storage location that holds one or more books.

**In context.** Each book is assigned to exactly one shelf when it is not on
loan.

**Distinguish from.** A reservation shelf used to hold books awaiting pickup,
which is out of scope for this vault.

> [!note] Notes
> Draft: shelf numbering scheme not yet agreed.
